metadata.title: Surrealist Ink Portrait with Psychedelic Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist ink-wash portrait featuring a nested, inverted face within the main subject and heavy psychedelic display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic ink-wash portrait of a woman wearing a headwrap, characterized by a surrealist 'nested' element where an inverted smaller face occupies the center of the main face. The style uses soft tonal gradients contrasted with sharp pen outlines and vibrant, outlined psychedelic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Nested inverted face centered within the primary facial structure
Soft ink-wash shading against stark black backgrounds
Vibrant red-outlined display type contrasting with monochromatic imagery
Organic, flowing lines of the headwrap framing the composition
coreInvariants: Inverted secondary face nested inside the primary face
Psychedelic display lettering with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary face is a large-scale close-up, filling the majority of the frame from the bottom edge to the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The inverted, smaller face located in the center-right of the main face acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large eyes of the main subject, moves down to the nested inverted face, and then follows the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the headwrap on the right and left edges, creating a high-contrast silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white paper/highlights and black ink; low saturation overall except for the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with thin internal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'A' with a circular, looped crossbar
Letters featuring mirrored or inverted orientations in the bottom text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative style used for both primary and secondary text to maintain psychedelic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic curves and decorative flourishes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist ink-wash portrait of a woman in a headwrap. In the center of her face, draw a smaller, inverted face that blends into her features. Use deep black for the background and soft gray washes for the skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom psychedelic bubble lettering in the top-left and bottom-right corners. The letters should be white with thick red outlines. The bottom text should be arranged in three lines, with the characters appearing inverted or mirrored.

verificationChecks: Is there a nested, inverted face within the main portrait?
Is the medium clearly ink-wash and pen?
Does the typography have thick red outlines and a psychedelic shape?
Is the bottom text block inverted/mirrored?

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the nested face
Fluid, hand-drawn quality in the lettering
avoid: Sharp vector edges on the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the nested face does not look like a simple sticker but is integrated into the wash.
Verify the red outline on the text is vibrant and thick.
Check that the background is a deep, solid black to provide contrast.
Confirm the psychedelic lettering maintains a hand-drawn, organic feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Ink Portrait [Subject] + Nested Inverted Face + Psychedelic [Color] Outlined Typography
